Sonu Nigam apologizes amid controversy over remarks ahead of Bengaluru concert

Singer Sonu Nigam has apologized ahead of his concert in Bengaluru following threats of disruption by the Karnataka Rakshana Vedike (KRV). The controversy stems from remarks he made in Pahalgam. The specific nature of the "Pahalgam remark" was not detailed in the provided coverage.
